title: Project screening (F2)
subtitle: Reps committee — review every F1 line and vote on each one
notAllowed: This page is for state reps only.
emptyPending: No proposals are waiting for the committee.
emptyDecided: No proposals have been decided yet.

quorum.title: Committee quorum
quorum.help: Each line goes with the majority (at least 2 of {{quorum}} reps); the project is rejected if two or more reps reject it. The decision is made once everyone has voted; you can change your vote until then.
quorum.notCountedHelp: This vote no longer counts: the rep has moved to the F1's own locality or another state, or their account is no longer active.

lines.title: F1 budget lines
lines.notePlaceholder: Reason for the condition or rejection (required)

missing: Vote on every line and give a reason for each conditional or rejected line ({{done}} of {{total}} done).
finalized: Quorum reached — the committee decision is final.
readOnly: View only — voting is for state reps.

decision.title: Committee decision (F2)
decision.approved: Screened — sent to the portal for final review and the MOU
decision.conditional: Conditional — returned to the room for review
